title: The Flat Sanitary Tee Mistake
description: Using a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal waste line is a frequent installation error in drainage systems. Sanitary tees are designed specifically for transitioning flow from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. When installed flat on horizontal runs, the tight turn fails to direct solid waste smoothly into the main stream. This abrupt direction change causes solids to settle, create turbulence, and cause recurring drain blockages over time. Professional plumbers always install a wye or combination tee-wye fitting on horizontal waste runs to maintain proper flow velocity and prevent clogs.

The Flat Sanitary Tee Mistake

Using a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal waste line is a frequent installation error in drainage systems. Sanitary tees are designed specifically for transitioning flow from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. When installed flat on horizontal runs, the tight turn fails to direct solid waste smoothly into the main stream. This abrupt direction change causes solids to settle, create turbulence, and cause recurring drain blockages over time. Professional plumbers always install a wye or combination tee-wye fitting on horizontal waste runs to maintain proper flow velocity and prevent clogs.
